title: Zip Line Adventure over Tampa Bay
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Weight range is between 70lbs and 270lbs limits are strictly enforced for guest safety
policies: Close toed shoes are mandatory, please prepare as if you’re going for a hike in the woods: no tank tops, short shorts (6-7” inseam is recommend due to the straps) or wet bathing suits and long hair must be tied back
Please note that tours run rain or shine, in the event of lightning guests will be brought down to wait out the storm - no refunds will be given due to weather
Arrival time is 30 minutes prior to your scheduled adventure, and late arrivals may not permitted to participate and no refund will be given
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Located in beautiful Oldsmar, Florida on the Mobbly Bayou Wilderness Preserve, this incredible Zip Line Adventure is 2 hours of pure excitement! 

All necessary gear is provided upon arrival. After check in, your tour guide will instruct and help you get into full body harnesses and attach the necessary gear needed to zip line. 

From start to finish you'll cover 5 zip lines ranging from 400-650 feet, a 200 foot suspension bridge, a high ropes course and an auto belay jump.This is one ride you won't want to miss! 

When the tour is over, your tour guides will help you out of your gear, and you'll have the chance to purchase photos of your adventure to show your family and friends!
